transcript.message: I'm gathering food, water, and fiber here. We should coordinate who gathers what.
This spot has water, forest, mountain, and plains nearby. Great settlement location. Let's cooperate - form a group, share labor, build infrastructure together.
I'm gathering water and fiber. We should coordinate to build a farm and storage here.
I'm on forest tile with wood. Gathering fiber and chopping wood to start building. Any interest in forming a group?
